snippet.title: Angry Birds 2: Gotta Fling Fast in the Sonic the Hedgehog Event!
snippet.description:
𝗚𝗼𝘁𝘁𝗮 𝗙𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗙𝗮𝘀𝘁, 𝗥𝗲𝗱! 𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗣𝗶𝗴𝘀 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗮𝘁 𝗶𝘁 𝗔𝗴𝗮𝗶𝗻! 🌀

Unite to protect the eggs in the Sonic the Hedgehog Event! For a limited time, join Red and Sonic to collect the Sonic Friends Hat Set in the “You’re Too Slow Adventure”!⭐

Speed through new challenges and dazzle the pigs with rings with the brand-new Sonic the Hedgehog Spell! 💫

Don’t miss the fun and all the activities we have planned in this ultimate team-up!
